name: Rimmlhof
beschreibung:
Overview

The Rimmlhof is a farm (country farm) in Rinnen near Berwang in the Tyrolean Zugspitz Arena, nestled in the mountain world of the Lechtal Alps. The Rimml family offers farm holidays with cosy rooms and lovingly furnished holiday apartments that combine traditional Tyrolean charm with modern comfort. Lots of solid wood furniture, plenty of wood and warm colours shape the atmosphere. The farm includes the Rimmlstube, where guests are treated to down-to-earth Tyrolean cuisine and seasonal specialities. Many specialities come directly from the farm itself, including lamb from the brown mountain sheep-Jura sheep as well as game from the farm's own and local hunting. House guests can book an evening menu in the Rimmlstube as an add-on to their stay.

History/Background

The Rimmlhof in Rinnen near Berwang has been closely linked to agriculture for generations. In the past, cows were kept on the farm and milk was produced, as was customary in the village for many years. Today the business devotes itself to sheep farming, which suits the mountain landscape and the conditions of the region. From the original brown Tyrolean mountain sheep, a rare and endangered breed, the family has in the meantime developed a cross with the Jura sheep that combines robustness with better meat yield. The sheep make an important contribution to landscape maintenance: by grazing the natural meadows, valuable areas remain open and the typical cultural landscape of the Tyrolean mountain world is preserved. Today the farm is one of the last livestock keepers in Rinnen. The hay comes from the farm's own mountain meadows, the farm's own forest supplies wood for the farm.

Arrival

The Rimmlhof is located at Rinnen 6, 6622 Berwang, Tyrol. According to the business, arrival is possible by car, bus, taxi or train; free parking spaces, a motorcycle shelter and a bicycle shelter are available. A railway station transfer is offered. From the farm it is around 70 metres to the entrance to the Rinnen-Berwang-Bichlbach ski lift network, to the cross-country ski trail and to the bus stop. The business is therefore also suitable for a holiday without a car.

Tips

Guests appreciate the farm experience with the brown mountain sheep and other farm animals such as rabbits and cats; children can help with haymaking or putting up fences. A heated outdoor swimming pool and a natural bathing lake provide bathing fun, and there is also an alpine pasture experience with a snack. Depending on the season, the farm offers homemade jams, fruit syrups, smoked sausages and fine carpaccio as well as sheepskins and raw sheep's wool. The range is complemented by organic honey from the neighbouring farm. Wi-Fi is free, children are welcome, a children's playground and a playhouse are available, dogs are allowed.

Best Travel Time

Around the Rimmlhof, nature can be experienced in every season. In summer, hiking, mountain tours, cycling and mountain biking adventures as well as motorcycle tours are in the foreground; in winter, skiing, snowboarding, cross-country skiing and snowshoe hiking. The entrance to the ski lift network, the cross-country ski trail and the bus stop are only around 70 metres away. A general recommendation for a particular month cannot be derived from the sources.
